faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by HLL Lifecare Limited (HLL) for its manufacturing unit located in Kanagala, Belgaum, Karnataka, offering permanent career opportunities.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being offered in HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: HLL Lifecare Limited is inviting applications for the post of Deputy General Manager (QA & QC) under advertisement number HLL/HR/083/2026 for a permanent position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is exactly 1 total vacancy available for the Deputy General Manager (QA & QC) post in this recruitment cycle across the organization.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master in Pharmacy degree along with relevant professional experience in pharmaceutical quality assurance and quality control functions.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is needed to apply for this post?
faq.answer: Applicants require a minimum of 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical QA/QC functions, including at least 5 years in a managerial or leadership role within a WHO-GMP compliant facility.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Deputy General Manager position is 45 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or pay scale for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a basic pay range of Rs. 70,000 to Rs. 2,00,000, with an approximate gross salary of Rs. 140,490 at the minimum of the scale.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for online application?
faq.answer: The application window opens on 7 October 2026 and closes on 31 October 2026, by which all interested and eligible candidates must submit their online applications.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for HLL DGM Recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of two primary stages: initial application screening of submitted documents followed by a personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for this vacancy?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online by accessing the designated Google Form, downloading and filling out the prescribed application form from the HLL website, and uploading it with necessary documents.
